guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is asserted low, count_q is cleared to 0; otherwise, on each rising clk_i edge, count_q takes the value of count_d.
guarantees.cond: rst_ni low (reset) or rising edge of clk_i

uncertain_points.claim: The intended range and function of the count_q counter are not defined within this chunk; count_d is driven externally, and the counter's legal values and overflow handling must be confirmed to ensure it does not disrupt the SBox masking scheme.
uncertain_points.cond: Depends on external logic generating count_d.
uncertain_points.risk: If count_d can produce out-of-range values or wrap incorrectly, the masking steps using count_q may fail or leak side-channel information.
